title: Density gap for minimizing cones
statement: For all P, j ∈ ℕ with j ≥ 1 there is δ > 0 with the following property: if C ∈ 𝒟_j(ℝ^P) is minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn C univ), ∂C = 0, C is a cone (IsConeCurrent C) and HasMassDensity C 0 θ (Θ^j(μ_C, 0) = θ) with θ < 1 + δ, then θ ≤ 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (P j : ℕ), 1 ≤ j → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) j) (θ : ℝ), IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → IsConeCurrent C → HasMassDensity C 0 θ → θ < 1 + δ → θ ≤ 1
